notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] added a bug report button
[*] fixed music cutting bug
[*] fixed game crash upon enemy movement in some edge cases
[*] updated compendium texts
[*] changed "leave trap" action not to consume unit turn
[*] neutral villages now don't spawn new units when the player unit is on them
[*] neutral villages now only become frightened by adjacent player units
[*] added shortcut for selecting the next unit or village
[*] added shortcut for sleeping and waking up
[*] changed treasure message
[/list]

Thanks for the reports and suggestions! If something was not changed or fixed yet, we are working on it. Wait for the future patches!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] fixed new enemy units showing up for a while even behind the clouds
[*] fixed animations not starting upon whole village destruction
[*] fixed field of view display problems
[*] fixed possibility of attacking the same unit multiple times before it flees
[*] changed battle and building sounds volume
[*] fixed crash upon enemy units number change
[*] fixed bad wheat orientation in brewery
[*] added achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Trailer and release date!
notes.notes:

Please remember to share your opinion either in the comments, via mail (vaeril.games@gmail.com) or in the survey ([url=https://forms.gle/7CxLKUWYPygamqaTA]https://forms.gle/7CxLKUWYPygamqaTA[/url]).
